{{Short description|French physicist (born 1947)}}
'''Dominique Langevin''' ({{IPA|fr|dɔminik lɑ̃ʒvɛ̃|-|Fr-Dominique Langevin.ogg}}; born 24 July 1947) is a French researcher in [[physical chemistry]]. She is research director at the [[Centre national de la recherche scientifique]] and leads the liquid interface group in the [[Laboratory of Solid State Physics]] at the [[University of Paris-Sud]].<ref name=who/><ref name=cnrs>{{cite book |date=2002 |url=http://www2.cnrs.fr/sites/band/fichier/3f16478181dac.pdf |title=Dominique LANGEVIN sciences chimiques |page=21 |series=les médailles d’argent |publisher= Délégation à l'information scientifique et technique du CNRS |language=fr}}</ref> She was the Life and Physical Sciences Panel chair for the European Space Sciences Committee of the [[European Science Foundation]] from 2013-2021.<ref name="ESSC">{{cite web |title=Dominique Langevin |url=https://www.essc.esf.org/panels-members/dominique-langevin%E2%80%8B/ |website=European Space Sciences Committee |access-date=21 March 2023}}</ref><ref name="Elkobrsi"/>

Langevin studies liquid interfaces and [[interfacial rheology]], the flow of matter at interfaces between liquids, or between a liquid and a gas. She is particularly interested in foams and emulsions and has made significant contributions relating the mechanical properties of interfaces to the stability of foams and emulsions.  She has had a major role in bringing together scientists and mathematicians from multiple disciplines to develop the field of foam and emulsion science.<ref name="Salonen">{{cite journal |last1=Salonen |first1=Anniina |last2=Drenckhan |first2=Wiebke |last3=Rio |first3=Emmanuelle |title=Interfacial dynamics in foams and emulsions |journal=Soft Matter |date=2014 |volume=10 |issue=36 |pages=6870–6872 |doi=10.1039/C4SM90104E |pmid=25115862 |bibcode=2014SMat...10.6870S |url=https://pubs.rsc.org/en/content/articlehtml/2014/sm/c4sm90104e?page=search |access-date=21 March 2023 |language=en|url-access=subscription }}</ref> Her books include ''Light Scattering by Liquid Surfaces and Complementary Techniques'' (1992)<ref name="Oss">{{cite journal |last1=Oss |first1=Carel J. van |title=A review of "Light Scattering by Liquid Surfaces and Complementary Techniques", Dominique Langevin, Ed., Marcel Dekker, New York, 1992; hardbound, pp. ix + 451, $150.00. |journal=Journal of Dispersion Science and Technology |date=1 December 1992 |volume=13 |issue=6 |pages=717 |doi=10.1080/01932699208943348 |url=https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/abs/10.1080/01932699208943348 |issn=0193-2691|url-access=subscription }}</ref> and  ''Emulsions, microemulsions and foams'' (2020).<ref>{{cite book |last1=Langevin |first1=D. |title=Emulsions, microemulsions and foams |date=2020 |location=Cham |isbn=9783030556815}}</ref>

==Early life==
The daughter of Maurice Cruchon and Jacqueline Maujean, she was born '''Dominique Anne-Marie Cruchon''' in [[Angoulême]]. In 1969, she married the mathematician Michel Langevin.<ref name=who>{{cite book |title=Who's Who in France |year=2003 |chapter=Dominique Langevin  |url=https://www.whoswho.fr/bio/dominique-langevin_49420}}</ref>

== Education==
She received a [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD]] from the women's [[École Normale Supérieure]] (ENS Sèvres) in [[Paris]], and did a third-cycle thesis at the [[Laboratoire Kastler-Brossel|Laboratory of Hertzian Spectroscopy]], supervised by [[Marie-Anne Bouchiat]]. Langevin conducted post-doctoral research at the [[Pierre Gilles de Gennes]] laboratory at the [[Collège de France]].<ref name=ecis/><ref name="Langevin">{{cite journal |last1=Langevin |first1=Dominique |title=An Adventure into the World of Soft Matter |journal=Annual Review of Condensed Matter Physics |date=10 March 2023 |volume=14 |issue=1 |pages=21–33 |doi=10.1146/annurev-conmatphys-040821-125850 |language=en |issn=1947-5454|doi-access=free |bibcode=2023ARCMP..14...21L }}</ref>

==Career==
During the 1970s, Langevin established the [[surfactant]] group at the École Normale Supérieure. During the early 1990s, she established the "Films de tensioactifs flexibles" research group. From 1994 to 1998, Langevin was director of the Centre de Recherche Paul Pascal in [[Bordeaux]].<ref name=ifs/><ref name="Langevin"/> She was president of the European Colloid and Interface Society from 1992 to 1993.<ref name=ecis>{{cite web |url=https://www.ecis-web.eu/awards/overbeek-medal/2012-dominique-langevin/ |title=2012 Dominique Langevin |publisher=European Colloid and Interface Society (ECIS)}}</ref>

==Research==
Her areas of research have included  the experimental study of [[soft matter]] physics, including the surface of [[liquid crystal]]s,  mixtures of [[surfactants]] and [[polymer]]s, the effects of nanoparticles on foams, foam drainage and soap film drainage, and the surface rheology of ultralow tension surfactant-oil-water systems.<ref name=ecis/><ref name="Langevin"/><ref name="Zamora">{{cite journal |last1=Zamora |first1=José M. |last2=Marquez |first2=Ronald |last3=Forgiarini |first3=Ana M. |last4=Langevin |first4=Dominique |last5=Salager |first5=Jean-Louis |title=Interfacial rheology of low interfacial tension systems using a new oscillating spinning drop method |journal=Journal of Colloid and Interface Science |date=June 2018 |volume=519 |pages=27–37 |doi=10.1016/j.jcis.2018.02.015|pmid=29477897 |bibcode=2018JCIS..519...27Z |s2cid=3534995 |url=https://hal.science/hal-04037300/file/Rheology%20spinning%20drop%20revised.pdf }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |last1=Marquez |first1=R |last2=Forgiarini |first2=AM |last3=Langevin |first3=D |last4=Salager |first4=JL |title=Instability of Emulsions Made with Surfactant-Oil-Water Systems at Optimum Formulation with Ultralow Interfacial Tension |journal=Langmuir |date=7 August 2018 |volume=34 |issue=31 |pages=9252–9263 |doi=10.1021/acs.langmuir.8b01376 |pmid=29986590 |s2cid=51609426 |url=https://hal.science/hal-04037136/file/Langmuir%20paper%20second%20revision.pdf }}</ref><ref name="Marquez">{{cite journal |last1=Marquez |first1=Ronald |last2=Forgiarini |first2=Ana M. |last3=Fernández |first3=Jesús |last4=Langevin |first4=Dominique |last5=Salager |first5=Jean-Louis |title=New Interfacial Rheology Characteristics Measured using a Spinning-Drop Rheometer at the Optimum Formulation of a Simple Surfactant-Oil-Water System |journal=Journal of Surfactants and Detergents |date=September 2018 |volume=21 |issue=5 |pages=611–623 |doi=10.1002/jsde.12163 |s2cid=102713729 |doi-access=free }}</ref> 

Langevin has made significant contributions relating the mechanical properties of interfaces to the stability of foams and emulsions. Her work has broad application in industry and medicine,  relating to preparation of foods and medicines, detergents, construction materials, fire-fighting, mineral extraction, recovery of pollutants, and nuclear waste treatment.<ref name="Salonen"/>
She has also worked with the European Space Agency (ESA), leading an international team to study the behavior of foams in [[microgravity]], in the FOAM-C (Foam and Optics Mechanics–Coarsening) experiment.<ref name="Elkobrsi">{{cite web |last1=Elkobrsi |first1=Shorouk |title=Celebrating Dominique Langevin's ESSC Journey |url=https://www.essc.esf.org/2021/11/26/celebrating-dominique-langevins-essc-journey/ |website=European Space Sciences Committee |access-date=21 March 2023 |date=26 November 2021}}</ref><ref name="Born">{{cite journal |last1=Born |first1=P. |last2=Braibanti |first2=M. |last3=Cristofolini |first3=L. |last4=Cohen-Addad |first4=S. |last5=Durian |first5=D. J. |last6=Egelhaaf |first6=S. U. |last7=Escobedo-Sánchez |first7=M. A. |last8=Höhler |first8=R. |last9=Karapantsios |first9=T. D. |last10=Langevin |first10=D. |last11=Liggieri |first11=L. |last12=Pasquet |first12=M. |last13=Rio |first13=E. |last14=Salonen |first14=A. |last15=Schröter |first15=M. |last16=Sperl |first16=M. |last17=Sütterlin |first17=R. |last18=Zuccolotto-Bernez |first18=A. B. |title=Soft matter dynamics: A versatile microgravity platform to study dynamics in soft matter |journal=Review of Scientific Instruments |date=1 December 2021 |volume=92 |issue=12 |pages=124503 |doi=10.1063/5.0062946 |pmid=34972443 |bibcode=2021RScI...92l4503B |s2cid=245396277 |url=https://aip.scitation.org/doi/full/10.1063/5.0062946 |issn=0034-6748}}</ref>

==Awards==
Langevin has received awards including:

* 2012, Kasha Mittala (Kash Mittal Award) for Surfactant in Solution Science<ref>{{cite news |title=Prestiżowe międzynarodowe wyróżnienie dla prof. Kazimiery Wilk |url=https://pwr.edu.pl/uczelnia/aktualnosci/prestizowe-miedzynarodowe-wyroznienie-dla-prof-kazimiery-wilk-12614.html |access-date=21 March 2023 |work=Politechnika Wrocławska |date=26 September 2022 |language=pl}}</ref>
* 2012, Overbeek Gold Medal, [[European Colloid and Interface Society]] (ECIS)<ref name=ecis/><ref name=ifs>{{cite web |url=https://tu-dresden.de/die_tu_dresden/fakultaeten/fakultaet_maschinenwesen/ism/sm/vortraege/Vortragsankndigung-Langevin_1_gesamt-1.pdf |title=Physical chemistry of foams |publisher=Institut für Strömungsmechanik}}</ref>
* 2009, European Ambassador for Creativity and Innovation, European Commission<ref name="EC">{{cite news |title=Official launch of the European Year of Creativity and Innovation 2009 |url=https://ec.europa.eu/commission/presscorner/detail/en/IP_09_3 |access-date=21 March 2023 |work=European Commission |date=5 January 2009 |language=en}}</ref> 
* 2006, Légion d’honneur<ref name="AE"/>
* 2005, [[L'Oréal-UNESCO Awards for Women in Science|L'Oréal-UNESCO Award for Women in Science]], "For her fundamental investigations of detergents, emulsions and foams".<ref>{{cite web |title=Laureates of the L'Oréal-UNESCO For Women in Science International Award  |url=https://www.fondationloreal.com/our-programs-women-science/laureates-loreal-unesco-women-science-international-award |website=Fondation l'Oréal |access-date=21 March 2023}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |title=L'Oréal and UNESCO Honor Five Women Physicists |journal=Physics Today |date=April 2005 |volume=58 |issue=4 |pages=76–77 |doi=10.1063/1.1955488|bibcode=2005PhT....58R..76. }}</ref>
*2002, CNRS silver medal, [[Centre national de la recherche scientifique]]<ref name="AE"/>
* 2004, {{Interlanguage link multi|Gentler-Kastler Prize|fr|3=Prix Gentner-Kastler}} of the [[Société Française de Physique]] and the [[Deutsche Physikalische Gesellschaft]]<ref name="AE"/>
* 2001, Elected, Academy of Europe<ref name="AE">{{cite web |title=Academy of Europe: Langevin Dominique |url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Langevin_Dominique |website=Academia Europaea |access-date=21 March 2023}}</ref>
* 1991, Grand prix de l’Académie des Sciences<ref>{{cite news |title=Les grands prix de l'Académie |url=https://www.lemonde.fr/archives/article/1991/11/27/les-grands-prix-de-l-academie_4031947_1819218.html |access-date=21 March 2023 |work=Le Monde |date=27 November 1991 |language=fr}}</ref><ref>{{cite book |title=Femmes scientifiques remarquables du XVIIIème siècle à nos jours |date=2017 |publisher=Femmes & Sciences Association |page=44 |url=https://www.medecinesciences.org/images/stories/news/Portraits-de-femmes-2017.pdf}}</ref>
